claims.evidence: The witness read the brand and model from the front panel in Photo 0.
The witness did not see a test print or the toner status screen.
The witness identified it as a large floor-standing photocopier with a scanner and ADF.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or has a faulty mainboard.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine booting up to the main menu screen.

risks.risk: Extremely high page count (meter reading) indicating the unit is near end-of-life.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the 'Meter' or 'Counter' screen showing total prints.
risks.if_unproven: As a high-mileage unit requiring immediate overhaul.

risks.risk: Poor print quality, such as streaks or faded colors due to damaged drums or empty toners.
risks.proof: A photo of a freshly printed 'Configuration Page' or 'Test Print'.
risks.if_unproven: As requiring a full set of toners and drum units.

risks.risk: Internal damage or moisture from being stored on a rough concrete floor or outdoors.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running a multi-page print job without jamming.
risks.if_unproven: As having compromised internal rollers and sensors.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and reaching the ready state.
Photo of the Counter/Meter screen showing total page counts.
Photo of a printed test page or internal status page.
Photos of the toner and imaging unit levels from the touchscreen menu.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified by the witness, allowing for a valuation based on its worst-case condition as a non-functional unit for parts.
